newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,816.9 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,816.9 mln Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 228.7 million Swiss francs to 3.82 billion in the reporting period ended December 10.
Statement of December 10 in millions of Swiss francs:
Lombard borrowing fell by nine million Swiss francs to zero in the reporting period.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 1,314.7 million francs to 1,073.1 million.

An SNB spokesman said the level of sight deposits was rather high and at the upper end of the range of fluctuation, but added that this should be seen in light of the increased demand for money toward the end of the year, which the SNB was meeting.
He said there were no tensions in the market and banks had not borrowed any money under the Lombard facility.
